title: Beatrix and the Thorn
author: Felix Quintana
blurb: Edmund Almeida, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the long winter finishes falling.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
